page_title: UDI 1-0 LEC | Udinese v Lecce 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jordan Zemura will be replaced by James Abankwah (Udinese).
90+2' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is caught offside!
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Udinese take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
89' A player from Lecce commits a rough challenge. Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
87' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 5:0.
86' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Maduka Okoye, who smothers the ball.
85' Udinese take a short corner kick.
85' Keinan Davis (Udinese) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
84' There's an opportunity for Iker Bravo (Udinese) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
84' Arthur Atta (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
83' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
81' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.
80' Dangerous play by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce). Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Substitution. Tete Morente (Lecce) replaces Ylber Ramadani.
79' Here's the change. Frederic Guilbert leaves the pitch and Remi Oudin (Lecce) comes on as a substitute.
78' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Iker Bravo (Udinese) replaces Lorenzo Lucca.
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Oier Zarraga as he is replaced by Arthur Atta (Udinese).
77' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Hassane Kamara (Udinese) but poses no threat.
75' 1 - 0 Jordan Zemura (Udinese) smashes the ball from the resulting free kick and it sails into the top right corner. The goalkeeper merely turned his head. Absolutely amazing.

74' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Udinese are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
74' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 11:9.
72' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sees a yellow card from Maurizio Mariani after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
71' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) plays a through ball but overhits it.
69' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
68' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
67' A substitution has been made. Kingsley Ehizibue goes off and Hassane Kamara (Udinese) comes on.
65' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
63' It will be a substitution. Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) is ready to enter the pitch as Ante Rebic walks off.
63' Here is a change. Balthazar Pierret is going off and Luca Gotti gives the last tactical orders to Hamza Rafia (Lecce).
62' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
58' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
57' 8:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
54' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and it's Keinan Davis (Udinese) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
53' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) is flagged for offside.
51' Keinan Davis (Udinese) has an effort from close range after latching on to a precise pass, but he can't beat one of the defenders who makes a good block.
51' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
48' Keinan Davis (Udinese) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
46' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brenner trots off the pitch and is replaced by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
43' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
38' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a decent header which rattles the left post!
36' A yellow card for a tackle by Ante Rebic (Lecce). Maurizio Mariani doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
36' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.

33' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from near the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
33' A corner kick by Udinese is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
28' Maurizio Mariani shows the yellow card to Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) for a heavy challenge.
25' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' The ball possession at the moment is 66:34.
18' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
14' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
11' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
7' A pass from Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone and the move breaks down.

4' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable save to keep the ball from hitting the net. What a save!
3' Udinese work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
3' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Maurizio Mariani.
